_nota: Fuentes: cronistas Bernabé Cobo (Historia del Nuevo Mundo, 1653) y Garcilaso de la Vega (Comentarios Reales, 1609) sobre los chasquis y el pescado fresco al Cusco; Qhapaq Ñan, Patrimonio Mundial de la UNESCO (2014), unos 30 000 km.
chas01-pescado: an Inca emperador in rich textiles at a stone palace table in Cusco with a plate of fresh fish, mountains through the window, golden light
chas02-corriendo: an Inca runner with a cloak and headband sprinting down a stone path on a steep Andean mountainside, motion, dust, sunrise
chas03-chasqui: portrait of a young Inca chasqui messenger with a woven bag and a conch shell trumpet, standing on an Andean stone road, epic light
chas04-relevo: two Inca runners passing a bundle from hand to hand next to a small stone hut on a mountain road, misty Andes, motion
chas05-pututo: an Inca runner blowing a large conch shell trumpet on a mountain path, sound waves in the misty air, dramatic light
chas06-quipu: close up of an Inca quipu with colorful knotted cotton cords held in hands, warm light, detailed texture
chas07-camino: the Inca road Qhapaq Nan winding along a dramatic Andean ridge with stone steps, aerial view, epic clouds
chas08-dos-dias: a basket of fresh fish being carried by an Inca runner through a high mountain pass at dawn, snowy peaks
chas09-final: silhouette of an Inca runner on top of a mountain at sunrise, endless Andes behind him, epic
